text: {"lessons":["My account has fluctuated, but it is slightly above its value in Period 1; a few periods are not enough to predict what comes next.","Making no trades has avoided impulsive decisions, but it has not prevented the account from changing in value, so I should keep reviewing whether its risk suits my retirement needs.","With no reliable information about future prices, I should avoid frequent trading and favor a cautious, diversified approach that I can stick with."]}
